recognize_zh: 中央一顆雙核巨大的巨噬細胞，灰藍色胞質內含多個橘紅色、圓形的被吞噬紅血球；右上另一顆巨噬細胞胞質中也含一顆紅血球與小顆暗色碎片，這就是紅血球吞噬（erythrophagocytosis）。
features: Large binucleate macrophage with abundant grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm containing multiple engulfed round orange-pink red cells
Second macrophage (upper right) with one nucleus, an ingested red cell, and a small dark inclusion consistent with nuclear debris
Macrophage nuclei round to oval with coarse chromatin
Adjacent erythroid precursors, including polychromatic normoblasts with clumped chromatin and a small dark orthochromatic form, at left
Background red cells with crenated (echinocytic) and irregular forms
describe_en: Aspirate smear shows two macrophages with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm; the larger, binucleate macrophage contains several intact phagocytosed red blood cells, and the second contains an ingested red cell and a small fragment of nuclear debris. Erythroid precursors are present nearby, and background red cells show crenation. Findings demonstrate erythrophagocytosis by macrophages, which may be seen in hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, immune hemolysis, infection, transfusion, or malignancy and must be interpreted with clinical and laboratory criteria rather than in isolation.

ddx.vs: Storage histiocytes contain lipid or ceroid (blue granules or wrinkled cytoplasm) rather than recognizable intact red cells.
Hemosiderin appears as coarse golden-brown to blue-black granules, confirmed by Prussian blue, rather than intact round erythrocytes.

ddx.dx: Tumor cells with emperipolesis (e.g., megakaryocyte or Rosai-Dorfman histiocyte)
ddx.vs: Emperipolesis shows intact cells passing within the cytoplasm without degradation, typically lymphocytes in S100-positive histiocytes or cells in megakaryocytes.

ddx.dx: Erythrophagocytosis by blasts (e.g., AML with t(8;16))
ddx.vs: In AML with KAT6A::CREBBP the phagocytic cells are monocytic blasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli rather than mature macrophages.
